name: Haltech WB2 (dual channel)
note: Every lambda field arrives UNSET, which is the point: set a lambda sensor's interface to CAN and point its frame and start bit at the field, so the reading comes with that sensor's calibration, operating window and P-codes instead of as a bare number on the bus. Two sensors in ONE frame, 20 Hz — WBI1 in bytes 0-1 and WBI2 in bytes 2-3, both with 32767 = free air. This template is the WB2A address; a second, third and fourth box go on 0x2B4, 0x2B6 and 0x2B8, so load this and change the id. Diagnostics are a nibble each in byte 6 (1 low battery, 2 high battery, 3 sensor short, 4 sensor open, 5 sensor cold).
